title: Your Libra Friend Cannot Pick a Restaurant
topic: Libra zodiac satire: a Libra cannot pick a restaurant
mechanism: Inside a Libra there is a giant scale labelled DECISIONS whose two sides are always perfectly level, a PLEASE EVERYONE dial turned all the way up, and a lucky coin with YES on both sides, so every choice ends in a tie and even a coin flip lands on its edge.

beats.hook: Minute forty in a parked car under a big LIBRA sign: Nina still can't choose where to eat
beats.story: Nina loves every idea equally; Kate demands tacos or pizza, Nina loves both; a three-column pros and cons list; the group-chat poll is a perfect tie
beats.rise: They find a restaurant with no menu at all; no choices, no fights; for the first time tonight Nina is winning
beats.twist: The waitress walks out of the kitchen with a tray: tonight you pick, chicken or fish; the whole table freezes
beats.mechanism: Inside her head: a giant scale DECISIONS always perfectly level (it wobbles and flings a menu), a PLEASE EVERYONE dial turned all the way up, a lucky coin with YES on both sides
beats.ending: Nina flips the coin, it lands on its edge, Kate bangs her head on the table, the kitchen closes; Nina goes home hungry and orders both; next week Kate asks where she wants to go for her birthday and Nina freezes again

seed.what: Nina's lucky coin (on the car dashboard in the hook, flipped at the restaurant)
